FINAL REPORT / CHARGE SHEET
(Under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C.)
In the Court of the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Fictionalpur

Police Station: Riverbend. FIR No. 0123/2023 dated 10.01.2023.
Offences: Sections 420, 406 and 120B IPC.
Complainant: Asha Testwoman, proprietor of Testwoman Traders, Fictionalpur.
Accused No. 1: Dev Fakename, s/o Mohan Fakename, Fictionalpur.
Accused No. 2: Sunil Mockwala, Riverbend Market, Fictionalpur.

Brief facts of the case:
The complainant alleges that between June and December 2022 the accused persons induced her to deposit Rs. 4,50,000 in a fictitious investment scheme on the strength of a forged partnership agreement, and later refused to return the money.
\f
Details of investigation:
The FIR was registered on 10.01.2023.
Both accused were arrested on 20.01.2023.
Accused No. 1 was released on bail by the Judicial Magistrate on 02.02.2023.
During investigation, the statements of witnesses LW-1 Ramesh Sampleman and LW-2 Geeta Demo were recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
The bank account statements and the original forged agreement were seized under a seizure memo dated 25.01.2023.
The questioned signatures were sent to the Forensic Science Laboratory, whose report dated 15.03.2023 states that the signatures on the agreement do not match the specimen signatures of the complainant.
A rubber stamp used on the agreement was recovered from the office of Accused No. 2.
The investigation having been completed, this charge sheet is filed on 30.04.2023 against both accused for offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120B IPC.

List of witnesses: LW-1 Ramesh Sampleman; LW-2 Geeta Demo; LW-3 Inspector Kavya Notreal, Investigating Officer.
List of documents: FIR; seizure memo; bank account statements; FSL report.
